name: ideagittool
description: The Rebased / IntelliJ git client, remade as a VS Code extension: git log with graph, commit tool window, shelf, branches popup, interactive rebase, push/update dialogs, conflicts resolver and annotations.

scripts.package: npm run contrib && node scripts/build.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository

ideagittool.gitPath.description: Path to the Git executable. Leave empty to use git from PATH.

enumDescriptions: Native VS Code look: buttons, inputs, lists, menus, colors and fonts of the current VS Code theme, with the IntelliJ layout.
IntelliJ New UI look: the IntelliJ light/dark palette (picked by the VS Code theme kind) and IntelliJ widget shapes.
ideagittool.appearance.description: Look of the IdeaGitTool views and dialogs. The layout and the features are the same in both.

ideagittool.untrackedFiles.description: How to show unversioned files in the Commit view.

ideagittool.showIgnoredFiles.description: Show ignored files in the Commit view.

ideagittool.repositoryScanMaxDepth.description: How deep to look for nested Git repositories below each workspace folder.

ideagittool.dialogs.openInNewWindow.markdownDescription: Open dialogs (Push, Rebase, Conflicts, …) and the merge window in their own window, like IntelliJ's floating dialogs, instead of an editor tab. Uses VS Code's *Move Editor into New Window*; the window size and position are chosen by VS Code.

ideagittool.fileStatusColors.description: Color file names in the Explorer and editor tabs by their Git status, like IntelliJ.

ideagittool.commit.gpgSign.description: Sign commits with GPG key (git commit -S). Like IntelliJ, this is a setting, not a commit option.

ideagittool.commit.includeActiveChangeli.description: Include new changes of the active changelist into the commit automatically (check them in the Commit tool window).

ideagittool.commit.skipHooks.description: Do not run Git commit hooks (commit always runs with '--no-verify').

ideagittool.intellijShortcuts.description: Use IntelliJ keyboard shortcuts for Git actions (Ctrl+T Update Project, Ctrl+Shift+K Push, Ctrl+Shift+` Branches, Alt+` VCS Operations Popup, Ctrl+Alt+N New Branch).

ideagittool.merge.useVsCodeMergeEditor.description: Resolve Manually… opens VS Code's merge editor instead of the IntelliJ-style three-pane merge window.

enumDescriptions: Ask once per workspace, when the first conflict appears.

Resolve conflicts with IdeaGitTool: turn off VS Code's merge conflict CodeLens and decorations (merge-conflict.codeLens.enabled, merge-conflict.decorators.enabled) and the automatic merge editor (git.mergeEditor). Run "Restore VS Code's Built-in Merge Conflict UI" to undo.
Keep VS Code's built-in conflict UI as it is; IdeaGitTool never changes those settings.
ideagittool.merge.handleConflicts.markdownDescription: Whether IdeaGitTool handles merge conflicts in the editor instead of VS Code's built-in conflict UI. IdeaGitTool changes VS Code's settings only after you agree (or choose `always` here).

ideagittool.merge.contextLines.description: Diff & Merge: the number of unchanged lines kept around changes by Collapse Unchanged Fragments in the merge window.

ideagittool.localHistory.enabled.description: Record Local History: file saves, creations, deletions, renames and external changes (git operations).

ideagittool.localHistory.retentionDays.description: Keep Local History for this number of days (IntelliJ: "Keep local history for N working days").

ideagittool.log.showInEditor.description: Show the log in the editor window, like Rebased. When off (the default), the log is shown in the "Git" panel at the bottom, like in JetBrains IDEs.

ideagittool.log.openOnStartup.description: Show the Git log when a workspace with a Git repository is opened (in the "Git" panel, or in the editor with ideagittool.log.showInEditor).

ideagittool.annotate.showAuthor.description: Annotate with Git Blame: show the author.

ideagittool.annotate.showDate.description: Annotate with Git Blame: show the date.

ideagittool.annotate.showRevision.description: Annotate with Git Blame: show the revision.

ideagittool.annotate.preferCommitDate.description: Annotate with Git Blame: show the commit timestamp instead of the author timestamp.

ideagittool.annotate.names.description: Annotate with Git Blame: how to show author names.

ideagittool.annotate.colors.description: Annotate with Git Blame: background colors by commit order (age), by author, or none.

ideagittool.annotate.ignoreWhitespace.description: Annotate with Git Blame: ignore whitespace changes (-w).

ideagittool.annotate.detectMovementsWith.description: Annotate with Git Blame: detect moved lines within the file (-M).

ideagittool.annotate.detectMovementsAcro.description: Annotate with Git Blame: detect lines moved from other files (-C).

ideagittool.inlineBlame.enabled.description: Show Git blame information inline: the author, date and subject of the last commit that changed the caret line, after the end of the line (like IntelliJ).

ideagittool.intellijShortcutsInEditor.description: Also use Ctrl+Shift+K for Push while a text editor has focus (it replaces VS Code's Delete Line).

enumDescriptions: Merge incoming changes into the current branch
Rebase the current branch on top of incoming changes
ideagittool.updateMethod.description: Update method used by Update Project.

ideagittool.update.showDialog.description: Show the Update Project dialog before updating.

ideagittool.update.saveChangesPolicy.description: Clean working tree using: Stash / Shelve. Local changes are saved before Update Project, Smart Checkout and Smart Merge, and restored afterwards.

ideagittool.push.tags.description: Push tags option of the Push dialog.

ideagittool.push.autoUpdateOnRejected.description: Update method to use silently when a push is rejected. Empty: ask with the Push Rejected dialog.

ideagittool.fetch.prune.description: Prune obsolete remote references on fetch.

ideagittool.branches.showRecent.description: Show recent branches in the Branches tab.

ideagittool.branches.showTags.description: Show tags in the Branches tab.

ideagittool.branches.groupByDirectory.description: Branches tab: group branches by directory ("feature/x" under a "feature" folder).

ideagittool.branches.groupByRepository.description: Branches tab: group branches by repository when the workspace has several repositories.

ideagittool.branches.searchActions.description: Branches tab: include actions (Update Project…, Commit…, …) in the search results.

ideagittool.branches.syncControl.description: Execute branch operations on all roots: with several repositories, branches that exist in all of them are shown once in the Branches tab and their actions run in every repository.

Jump to Source from Diff
